component.name: RendezvousTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" end sub
sub runTask() ' Continuously rendezvous with the render thread (a cross-thread field set), so an ECP ' client can start tracking at any point and still observe an event shortly after. while true m.top.counter = m.top.counter + 1 sleep(200) end while end sub
